method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (an infringement amount the Act does not set answers NOTHING, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Road Vehicle Standards Act 2018, Compilation No. 3, compilation date 1 January 2025 (includes amendments up to Act No. 35, 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2018A00163.txt. No instrument brought in: the Road Vehicle Standards Rules 2018 and the Secretary's s 6 instruments are not deposited and are asked as facts; the value of a penalty unit (Crimes Act 1914 s 4AA) is an input.

checks.command: l4 run rvsa-owner.l4 ; l4 run rvsa-cases-owner.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the individual importing, buying or selling a vehicle: road vehicle (s 6), permission to import (s 22), first provision of a vehicle not on the RAV and its exceptions (s 24), modification of an RAV vehicle before it reaches a consumer (s 26), use despite State or Territory standards (s 78), and the maximum penalties for an individual (ss 16-18, 22, 24, 26-32, 38-40) with the s 56(2) infringement amounts. Out: components beyond the penalty list, the standards, registers and Rules (ss 12-15, 19-21, 23, 25), s 16(3), ss 33-35, body corporate penalties, Part 3 Divisions 2 and 4, Parts 4-5, ss 76-77, 79-82.
seat: the individual importing a vehicle, or buying or selling one that may not meet the national standards
